scientific_integrity: Exact face decomposition and nullhomotopic cofibration supply the unbounded-parameter proof; mod-two finite checks separately corroborate. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: This is an integral homotopy classification of the combinatorial Alexander dual, and only an integral homology/persistence classification of the ordinary cut complex; assumes a,b at least four and a one-hub deleted star. The finite modular verification is not a universal proof. Equivalent unindexed prior work remains possible.
title: Star-edge deletion in bipartite three-cut complexes: integral homotopy and two-degree persistence
